description: A free collection of small browser games from Work & Money Los Angeles. Every game is free, plays instantly in a web browser, and needs no signup, no download, and no payment.

games.description: Thirteen pendulum balls swing at slightly different tempos, drift into chaos, then come back together.
games.goal: Call the exact moment all thirteen balls snap into one perfect straight line.
games.name: Pendulum Wave: Call It!

games.controls: Drag to aim, release to fire; or arrow keys and Space.
games.description: Aim and fire balls through glowing multiplier gates (x2, x3, x5, x10); balls that pass through a gate multiply, and banked balls count toward the target.
games.name: Ball Multiplier — Beat 501

games.controls: Hold anywhere, or hold Space, to squeeze; release to open.
games.description: Squeeze two crushers to pop jelly balls caught inside the diamond; every popped ball spawns 2 more, so chains escalate fast.
games.name: Jelly Pop Cascade

games.controls: Tap where you want to dash, or swipe to dash in that direction.
games.description: Sword vs. dagger in a dash-duel arena. A dashing hit deals full damage, and every hit makes the winner stronger: more levels, more size, more damage.
games.goal: Reduce the rival to zero HP; best of 3 rounds takes the duel.
games.name: Weapon Duel

games.controls: Drag on the dish to aim the chute, release to drop, or tap DROP.
games.description: Drop balls into a dish so they thread the moving gold point; every thread multiplies the swarm in the Fibonacci sequence (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13...). Balls that bounce out are lost.
games.name: Fibonacci Dish

games.description: Twenty-five pendulums swing at twenty-five different beats; pulses push the field toward one shared tempo while drift pushes back.
games.goal: Bring all 25 pendulums into one synchronized swing.
games.name: Metronome Sync

games.controls: Drag, swipe, or Left/Right arrow keys / A and D to steer.
games.description: A 3D runner where you steer an orb and smash through walls whose strength is no greater than your power; every smash makes you stronger, and a mega wall waits every 500 meters.
games.goal: Survive and score: distance plus smashes.
games.name: Orb Smash 3D

name: The Arcade Room
